working_definition: The six outer photoreceptors R1-R6 of the compound eye, present collectively in each ommatidium. They express Rhodopsin 1 (Rh1/ninaE), have cell bodies in the retina, and their axons terminate in the lamina where they form extensive synaptic connections with lamina monopolar neurons (L1-L5). They are the primary photoreceptors of the achromatic/motion visual pathway.

best_match.fbbt_definition: An eye photoreceptor cell whose rhabdomere is part of the outer trapezoid of rhabdomeres of each ommatidium. There are six of these per ommatidium. Each has a single axon that projects along a single lamina optic cartridge within which it makes extensive synaptic connections before terminating in the proximal lamina. It is strongly presynaptic to lamina monopolar neurons L1 and L2 and the lamina intrinsic (amacrine) neuron (Rivera-Alba et al., 2011).

justification: FBbt:00006007 'outer photoreceptor cell' directly encodes the R1-R6 grouping: it specifies six cells per ommatidium, rhabdomeres forming the outer trapezoid, single axons projecting into lamina cartridges, and strong presynaptic connections to L1/L2 and the lamina amacrine neuron — exactly matching the cluster's anatomy, location, and connectivity. The cluster label R1.6 is shorthand for the outer photoreceptors R1-R6 taken together; FBbt:00006007 is the canonical grouping term for this set. Individual R1-R6 FBbt terms exist (FBbt:00004213-00004223) but are more specific than the cluster, which does not resolve subtypes. No new term is needed.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Outer photoreceptor cell of the adult eye whose rhabdomere is located at the right angle vertex of the longer of the two parallel sides of the trapezoid of rhabdomeres in each ommatidium. It has a single axon that projects along a single lamina optic cartridge (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Wolff and Ready, 1993).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: More specific than the cluster: this term refers to photoreceptor cell R1 only. The cluster aggregates all six outer photoreceptors R1-R6 and does not distinguish individual subtypes; the parent grouping term FBbt:00006007 is the correct level.

recommendation: Accept FBbt:00006007 'outer photoreceptor cell' as an exact match. The term was designed for precisely this grouping (R1-R6, six per ommatidium, lamina-projecting), and the cluster label and biology align completely.
